current_suggestion.pitch: Your health channels skew heavily carnivore/low-carb (Saladino, Chaffee, Berry), so Sigma Nutrition Radio provides a rigorous counterweight: host Danny Lennon interviews researchers and clinicians and stress-tests nutritional claims with direct reference to study methodology, effect sizes, and confounding — the kind of granular skepticism that keeps any single dietary framework honest. Where your current channels often start from a conclusion and build a case, Lennon typically starts from the evidence and follows it, including when it's inconclusive. Format is primarily long-form interview and solo deep-dives, with consistent attention to what the data actually supports versus what's being extrapolated.
